faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Guest Lecturer (Psychology) position at Government RBRA NES Postgraduate College Jashpur is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Lecturer (Psychology) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Guest Lecturer (Psychology) post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Guest Lecturer (Psychology) post are as per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Lecturer position will be based on a Merit List.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: You can download the application form from the official website of Government RBRA NES Postgraduate College Jashpur, which is rbmesjashpur.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Guest Lecturer position is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 389 / Guest Lecturer / 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Which city and state is this college located in?
faq.answer: The college is located in Jashpurnagar, Chhattisgarh.
